items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled native table, header, body, footer, row, cell, and caption parts.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: TanStack Table v9 for Remix: typed columns, sorting, filtering, pagination, visibility, selection, and composable controls.

items.name: theme
items.title: Stems UI theme
items.description: shadcn/ui CSS variables (neutral), plus tw-animate-css and shadcn/tailwind.css (the same imports `shadcn init` adds). cssVars are generated from src/styles/theme.css at build time; keep `css` in sync with its @layer base block.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn()
items.description: Class name merging with cn.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content. Behavior: stems-ui/separator.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions triggered by a button, with checkbox and radio items and submenus. Behavior: stems-ui/menu.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A control that indicates whether a setting is on or off. Behavior: stems-ui/switch.

items.name: toggle-button
items.title: Toggle Button
items.description: A two-state button that can be on or off (shadcn's toggle). Behavior: stems-ui/toggle-button.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content, displayed one at a time. Behavior: stems-ui/tabs.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button. Behavior: stems-ui/button.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A native text input with state data attributes. Behavior: stems-ui/input.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user. Behavior: stems-ui/avatar.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Displays the completion status of a task. Behavior: stems-ui/progress.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A graphical display of a numeric value within a range. Behavior: stems-ui/meter.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: An interactive component which expands/collapses a panel. Behavior: stems-ui/collapsible.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content. Behavior: stems-ui/accordion.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short, temporary notifications (Sonner-style API). Behavior: stems-ui/toast.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An accessible popup anchored to a button. Behavior: stems-ui/popover.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A popup that opens on top of the entire page. Behavior: stems-ui/dialog.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A dialog that requires a user response to proceed. Behavior: stems-ui/alert-dialog.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen, with swipe-to-dismiss. Behavior: stems-ui/drawer.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A popup that shows a short hint when an element is hovered or focused. Behavior: stems-ui/tooltip.

items.name: preview-card
items.title: Preview Card
items.description: A popup that previews a link's destination on hover or focus (shadcn's hover card). Behavior: stems-ui/preview-card.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu opened by right click, long press, or Shift+F10 at the pointer. Behavior: stems-ui/context-menu.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A control for toggling an option on or off. Behavior: stems-ui/checkbox.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of options where only one can be selected. Behavior: stems-ui/radio-group, stems-ui/radio.

items.name: toggle-button-group
items.title: Toggle Button Group
items.description: A set of toggle buttons with shared state (shadcn's toggle-group). Behavior: stems-ui/toggle-button-group.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A button that opens a list of options to pick one or more values. Behavior: stems-ui/select.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldSet, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, FieldContent, FieldTitle. Behavior: stems-ui/field, stems-ui/fieldset.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A native form with field validation and server errors. Behavior: stems-ui/form.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a value or a range by dragging thumbs along a track. Behavior: stems-ui/slider.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A numeric input with stepper buttons, scrubbing, and locale formatting. Behavior: stems-ui/number-field.

items.name: otp-field
items.title: OTP Field
items.description: A one-time code input made of single-character slots. Behavior: stems-ui/otp-field.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: An input with a filterable list of options; one value or several shown as chips. Behavior: stems-ui/combobox.

items.name: autocomplete
items.title: Autocomplete
items.description: A free-text input with suggestions and optional inline completion. Behavior: stems-ui/autocomplete.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A native scroll container with custom scrollbars. Behavior: stems-ui/scroll-area.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A horizontal bar of menus, like a desktop application menu. Behavior: stems-ui/menubar, stems-ui/menu.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A container for grouping buttons and controls with one tab stop. Behavior: stems-ui/toolbar.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A collection of links and menus for website navigation, with a shared morphing viewport. Behavior: stems-ui/navigation-menu.
